title: Civil War II X-Men #1 Marvel 2016 Cullen Bunn Magneto Storm Psylocke Yardin
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Civil War II: X-Men #1 (2016), Marvel Comics - first issue of the 4-issue tie-in. Written by Cullen Bunn, art by Andrea Broccardo, colors by Jesus Aburtov, David Yardin cover with Magneto, Storm, Medusa, Psylocke and Old Man Logan. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Marvel Legends Series Ant-Man / Giant Man Build-A-Figure ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
